These implantable devices come in many forms and clinical uses, such as in bone putties, stents, wound dressings and sutures. While the ISO 10993 series of standards prescribe the methods and risk assessments required to evaluate the safety of a medical device, the approach and overall risk to be assessed varies greatly from device to device.
